gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Expose packs its caps and lowercase almost shoulder to shoulder, a tight, striking line with barely a breath in it. And Noto Sans Sunuwar loosens everything up below, its curves leaving daylight and its short ascender stems keeping paragraphs friendly.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nagri: Noto Sans Syloti Nagri reads tall and compact, with short ascenders and an a whose lower bowl opens up to breathe. Expose supplies the sharp, squeezed headline voice above it.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Expose is all compression, its lowercase rising nearly to the caps with hardly a pause between them. But Noto Sans Syriac answers in rounded, bulb-like bowls and wide, easy s turns, so extended reading feels approachable and modern.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-syriac-easter: Noto Sans Syriac Eastern keeps its lowercase tall and its curve endings well apart. Expose sits above it in tight, striking display letters, and the two make a pleasing tension between pinched headline and open text.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-syriac-wester: Expose is the refined, tightly spaced voice here, with caps and lowercase nearly level in height. Yet Noto Sans Syriac Western does the quieter job, holding its terminals far from the strokes so small text stays clear and modern.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Noto Sans Tagalog reads with the middle zone of the line doing most of the work, and its curves stay generously open. Expose is the sharp, compressed counterpoint, and that tight-versus-open gap is the pair's best quality.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Expose sets a striking, refined tone, its x-height crowding right up against the caps in a compressed rhythm. Noto Sans Tagbanwa then fills most of the line height with open curves and clear gaps, and that spacious, modern text is the pair's draw.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Expose is a display face at its best, squeezing caps and lowercase into a tight, striking line. Noto Sans Tai Le is the opposite sort of good, with strokes that taper out before touching and a barely noticeable step from capitals to small letters.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Noto Sans Tai Viet keeps things short and tall. Its low ascenders, large x-height and terminals pulled back from each curve make long text feel approachable, while Expose adds a striking, tightly packed headline above.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-takri: Noto Sans Takri reads high-waisted and open, every small round letter leaving its curve generously unclosed. Expose does the headline work, with a refined, compressed punch the text face never attempts.
